label: Bible Study
prompt: When Israel was a child, then I loved him, and called my _____ out of Egypt.
verse: When Israel was a child, then I loved him, and called my son out of Egypt.
note: Matthew sees this fulfilled when the young Jesus returns from Egypt with Mary and Joseph.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: Then sang Moses and the children of Israel this song unto the LORD, and spake, saying, I will sing unto the LORD, for he hath triumphed gloriously: the horse and his rider hath he thrown into the _____.
verse: Then sang Moses and the children of Israel this song unto the LORD, and spake, saying, I will sing unto the LORD, for he hath triumphed gloriously: the horse and his rider hath he thrown into the sea.
note: The Song of the Sea begins on the far shore: horse and rider thrown into the sea.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And Moses said, I will now turn _____, and see this great sight, why the bush is not burnt.
verse: And Moses said, I will now turn aside, and see this great sight, why the bush is not burnt.
note: Moses' curiosity started it all: he turned aside to look, and God spoke from the bush (Exodus 3:4).

label: Deep Water
prompt: Raging waves of the sea, foaming out their own shame; _____ stars, to whom is reserved the blackness of darkness for ever.
verse: Raging waves of the sea, foaming out their own shame; wandering stars, to whom is reserved the blackness of darkness for ever.
note: Jude's word pictures for false teachers: wild waves foaming shame, and stars drifting off course into darkness.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: Which also said, Ye men of Galilee, why stand ye _____ up into heaven? this same Jesus, which is taken up from you into heaven, shall so come in like manner as ye have seen him go into heaven.
verse: Which also said, Ye men of Galilee, why stand ye gazing up into heaven? this same Jesus, which is taken up from you into heaven, shall so come in like manner as ye have seen him go into heaven.
note: Two men in white at the Ascension, gently: why stand ye 'gazing'? He'll come back the same way he left.
